summary: Add seedRowForTable cases for 6 missing tenant tables (invoke_proposal, notification, email_channel_config, notification_preference, report_page, report_page_dep) plus a guard that fails if any known_tenant_tables.txt entry lacks a seeder — resolving 75+ skipped cross-tenant probes.
functional: Seeder for invoke_proposal: no FK deps, minimal row (caller_id/target_id = fresh UUIDs, status='proposed')
Seeder for notification: FK to employee via recipient_id — uses seedState.empId per tenant
Seeder for email_channel_config: PK=(tenant_id), ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, no FK deps
Seeder for notification_preference: PK=(tenant_id, event_kind, recipient_scope), no FK deps
Seeder for report_page: FK to application via app_id — uses seedState.appId per tenant; id stored in seedState.reportPageId{A,B}
Seeder for report_page_dep: FK to report_page (page_id) + registry_def (registry_def_id) — uses seedState.reportPageId and seedState.regId per tenant
Guard describe block inside cross_tenant.test.ts: SEEDED_TABLES set vs KNOWN_TENANT_TABLES; missing entry = red test
non_functional: Additive only: no existing cases, functions, or imports removed
Two consecutive fitness:db runs are idempotent
out_of_scope: Fixing effect_resource missing break (pre-existing bug, separate task)

acceptance_criteria.text: seedRowForTable has explicit case entries for invoke_proposal, notification, email_channel_config, notification_preference, report_page, report_page_dep
beforeAll completes without error against a migrated DB (0 beforeAll failures)
0 skipped tests in cross_tenant.test.ts when run against a live DB
Guard test is red if a table in KNOWN_TENANT_TABLES is absent from SEEDED_TABLES
Two consecutive fitness:db runs produce identical pass/fail results
